observation: B's UI displayed “Using other chats — 1 other chat used”, yet B's captured request contained no other-conversation text, no project names and no cross-chat label. The badge is a UI indication of retrieval activity; the payload is what reached the provider. Flagged as a labelling nuance to review, not as leakage.
redaction: Only booleans, character counts and two short assistant sentences are recorded. The full request bodies contain system prompts and tool schemas and are not committed.
limitations: A browser that is closed loses the capture buffer; payloads were read from the live page before closing.
No OpenRouter request was observed in this session, so no OpenRouter claim is made.
